title: Job order
description: The fields every job order of the member's set carries, whatever its kind; the kind schemas add their progress. No holder, amount per person, provision, fee, movement, recipient, unit commitment, claim, Bank state, history or other member's note is ever carried. Job-order data is kept at most 7 days, in memory only, never in a backup or diagnostics and never forwarded.

id.description: The order's id and the feed key. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

number.description: The order's running number, shown as #number. A display field only: no route accepts it.

priority.description: The order's place in the queue; null once the order is closed.

supportingUnits.description: The org units that actively support the order; ended support is not listed.

updatedAt.description: The last change of a field this read carries.

relations.description: The member's own relations to the order, at least one, in this order: a unit the member directly belongs to requests it, is responsible for it or actively supports it, or the member works on it as an assignee.

comment.description: The author's comment as plain text; render it as text, never as markup or a link.

responsibilityInvalid.description: The responsible unit no longer holds a valid Profit responsibility; nothing can be written until it is fixed in the Basetool.

link.description: Opens this order in the Basetool. Open it only after checking it is https on the Basetool's host.

assignees.description: The members working on the order; a member who withholds their name from connected applications is left out.

ref.description: A per-client pseudonym of the member: the same in every answer to this client, different for every other client.

own.description: Whether the entry is the acting member's own.

note.description: The acting member's own note on their own entry; null on every other entry and when they wrote none.

versions.description: The section versions a client write echoes.

target.description: The aUEC target's version; null on MATERIAL and ITEM orders.
